name: strudel-ide
description: A minimal live coding music environment powered by Strudel in the browser and and IDE with vite HMR to apply changes.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.types.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:all: npm run -s check && npm run -s test:build && npm run -s test:e2e
scripts.check: npm run -s typecheck && node scripts/audit-types.mjs --strict --quiet && node scripts/check-songs.mjs && node scripts/test-locations.mjs && npm run -s test:bridge && npm run -s ext:check
